notes: Inventory commit is 4f04aef; audit commit 4523908, product code identical. Five Contradicted claims, four in crypto: (1) K9 PinHmacKeyProvider falls back to a hard-coded static HMAC key when the Keystore throws; (2) the app shell's R01 unlock goes to R02 on any PIN, so Argon2id, lockout and K9 never run in the shipped flow; (3) BundleManifestVerifier trusts only DEFAULT_TEST_K3_PUBLIC_HEX, whose private key is committed in tools/sign_bundle_manifest.py line 25; (4) backend/app/config.py defaults ENROLLMENT_CODE_SECRET to a fixed public string with no startup guard. The fifth, K2 location (CI secret vs founder's machine), is crypto-area too but likely doc drift. Also notable: the app lock never engages on cold start (no lock() call); KeystoreRecoveryManager and ResearchSessionManager are not wired into :app; no S8 restore-recency gate; no OSV, MobSF or Schemathesis. No real newborn data seen.
